title: Pocketwire Rewards High-Spender Anniversary Bonus Schedule
content:
For Pocketwire Rewards members whose anniversary spend of the membership year reaches 30000 USD, the anniversary bonus takes a spend-based or blended form as follows.

## Rule

When the anniversary spend of the membership year is at least 60000 USD, the anniversary bonus is computed as that spend multiplied by 0.11 points per USD, rounded down to whole points, in place of the anniversary tier amount; when it is at least 30000 USD but below 60000 USD, the anniversary bonus is the anniversary tier amount plus that spend above 30000 USD multiplied by 0.05 points per USD, the added part rounded down to whole points. When the spend is below 30000 USD, no such adjustment applies.

## Definitions

- The anniversary spend of the membership year is the spend carried by earning entries dated within the last twelve months less the spend carried by clawback entries dated within the same twelve months.
- Earning entries are the entries that credit base and category points on a card purchase; boost entries, which carry the same purchase's spend, are not earning entries.
- A date lies within the last twelve months when it is later than the same calendar day twelve months before the handling date and not later than the handling date.
- The anniversary tier amount is the anniversary bonus points of the tier held on the credit date.

## Spend bands

| Anniversary spend of the membership year | Anniversary bonus |
|---|---|
| at least 60000 USD | the spend multiplied by 0.11 points per USD, rounded down, in place of the anniversary tier amount |
| at least 30000 USD, below 60000 USD | the anniversary tier amount plus the spend above 30000 USD multiplied by 0.05 points per USD, the added part rounded down |
| below 30000 USD | no such adjustment |

## Worked examples (hypothetical ledgers)

- Earning entries in the window carry 74210.00 USD and clawback entries 1859.60 USD. The anniversary spend is 72350.40 USD, at least 60000 USD: 72350.40 multiplied by 0.11 is 7958.544, rounded down to 7958 points.
- The anniversary spend is 41237.00 USD and the anniversary tier amount is 1000 points. The spend above 30000 USD is 11237.00 USD; multiplied by 0.05 it is 561.85, rounded down to 561. The bonus is 1000 plus 561, which is 1561 points.

## Boundary cases

- A spend of exactly 60000.00 USD takes the spend-based form: 6600 points.
- A spend of exactly 30000.00 USD takes the blended form with an added part of 0: the anniversary tier amount.
- A spend of 29999.99 USD is below 30000 USD: no such adjustment.
- Handled on 20 March 2025, an earning entry dated 21 March 2024 is within the last twelve months; one dated 20 March 2024 is not.
